title: Origin story: Enkidu
description: Enkidu was shaped by the gods from clay and released in the wilderness, living as a beast among beasts until the temple woman Shamhat civilized him. He became Gilgamesh's truest friend, standing with him against Humbaba and the Bull of Heaven — and died by the gods' decree for it.
